{{Quote|''Implacable'' is the kind of name they give to Imperial capital ships.|[[Kell Tainer]]|<ref name="Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Implacable''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] of unknown specification commanded by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Apwar Trigit]], who served first under [[Ysanne Isard]], and then under [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], in the years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It was destroyed in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] by [[Wraith Squadron]], in the [[Battle of Ession]].
